(Published by Authority)PART IV (B) — LOCAL GOVERNMENT
Local Government Notifications
NOTICE FOR MEETING UNDER THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES (AMENDMENT) ACT, No. 22 OF 2012

I, Thevanthini Babu, Commissioner of Local Government, Northern Province by virtue powers vested to me under Sub Section No. 66 (C) of Local Authorities Elections (Amendment) Act, No.22 of 2012, hereby notify to convene the first meeting for the election of Mayor/ Chairman, Deputy Mayor/Vice Chairman for the Local Authorities in Northern Province scheduled below according to the date, time and venue specified below.
Thevanthini Babu, Commissioner of Local Government, Northern Province. Department of Local Government,Northern Province,Elders Home Complex,A9 Road, Kaithdy, Jaffna. 02nd June 2025.Schedule
